name: Weave Everything
description: 在输入网格的表面散布曲线，并通过控制场调整曲线的显现、缩放和扰动。可用于制作纤维覆盖、编织表面和动态生长效果。
notes: 单根纤维的形状由指定的曲线物体决定，生成范围由“动画”输入控制。生成的曲线存放在输出几何捆包的“曲线”项中，推荐在单独的毛发曲线物体中用“获取几何体捆包”和“分离捆包”读取。
example: 接入沿高度变化的数值场（如位置 Z 减去偏移值）作为“动画”输入，调整偏移即可让纤维带沿模型表面移动。

inputs.name: 几何数据
inputs.description: Mesh the curves are scattered on. It should contain faces.
inputs.de: Mesh the curves are scattered on. It should contain faces.
inputs.dz: 用于散布曲线的网格。输入应包含面。

inputs.name: 切割网格
inputs.description: Trims the mesh by the 动画 (Animation) field, keeping the region where the field is positive. When off, the original mesh is kept.
inputs.de: Trims the mesh by the 动画 (Animation) field, keeping the region where the field is positive. When off, the original mesh is kept.
inputs.dz: 根据“动画”输入裁切网格，保留控制场的正值区域。关闭时保留原网格。

inputs.name: Material
inputs.description: Material assigned to the generated curves.
inputs.de: Material assigned to the generated curves.
inputs.dz: 指定生成曲线使用的材质。

inputs.name: Resolution
inputs.description: Precision used when converting and resampling the curves. Higher values keep more curve detail at a higher computation cost.
inputs.de: Precision used when converting and resampling the curves. Higher values keep more curve detail at a higher computation cost.
inputs.dz: 曲线转换与重采样使用的精度。较高的值可以保留更多曲线细节，同时增加计算量。

inputs.name: Radius
inputs.description: Overall multiplier on the final radius of the generated curves, applied after 粗细 (Thickness) and the growth scaling.
inputs.de: Overall multiplier on the final radius of the generated curves, applied after 粗细 (Thickness) and the growth scaling.
inputs.dz: 生成曲线最终半径的整体倍数，在“粗细”和生长缩放之后作用。

inputs.name: 抖动速率
inputs.description: How fast the jitter changes with the 动画 (Animation) input. While that input stays constant, the jitter does not change over time on its own.
inputs.de: How fast the jitter changes with the 动画 (Animation) input. While that input stays constant, the jitter does not change over time on its own.
inputs.dz: 控制扰动随“动画”输入变化的速度。动画输入保持不变时，扰动不会自行随时间变化。

inputs.name: 混乱程度
inputs.description: Spatial scale of the noise. Higher values make the jitter finer.
inputs.de: Spatial scale of the noise. Higher values make the jitter finer.
inputs.dz: 控制噪声的空间尺度。较高的值使扰动变化更细碎。

inputs.name: 抖动力度
inputs.description: Strength of the noise displacement on the curves.
inputs.de: Strength of the noise displacement on the curves.
inputs.dz: 控制噪声对曲线位移的影响强度。

inputs.name: 偏向
inputs.description: Distribution of displacement strength across curves. Negative values give more curves a weaker displacement; positive values give more curves a stronger one.
inputs.de: Distribution of displacement strength across curves. Negative values give more curves a weaker displacement; positive values give more curves a stronger one.
inputs.dz: 调整各根曲线的位移强度分布。负值使更多曲线采用较弱的位移，正值使更多曲线采用较强的位移。

inputs.name: 动画
inputs.description: Controls where curves appear and how they grow. Curves are generated near the zero value of the field and are scaled larger the closer they are to zero. Connect a spatially varying field to form a local fiber band, and move the field to move the band across the surface.
inputs.de: Controls where curves appear and how they grow. Curves are generated near the zero value of the field and are scaled larger the closer they are to zero. Connect a spatially varying field to form a local fiber band, and move the field to move the band across the surface.
inputs.dz: 控制曲线出现的区域和生长缩放。曲线在控制场的零值附近生成，越接近零值，缩放越大。接入空间变化的数值场，可在模型表面形成局部纤维带；改变该场的位置，可使纤维带沿表面移动。

inputs.name: 宽度
inputs.description: Width of the range around zero in which curves are generated. Larger values widen the range. Use a value greater than zero.
inputs.de: Width of the range around zero in which curves are generated. Larger values widen the range. Use a value greater than zero.
inputs.dz: 控制零值附近生成曲线的范围。较大的值扩大生成范围。应使用大于零的值。

inputs.name: 过渡
inputs.description: Scale falloff inside the generation range. With positive values, larger values concentrate curves closer to the zero value of the field.
inputs.de: Scale falloff inside the generation range. With positive values, larger values concentrate curves closer to the zero value of the field.
inputs.dz: 控制生成范围内的缩放变化。使用正值时，较大的值使曲线更集中于控制场的零值附近。

inputs.name: 实例
inputs.description: Curve object used as a single fiber.
inputs.de: Curve object used as a single fiber.
inputs.dz: 指定作为单根纤维使用的曲线物体。

inputs.name: 粗细
inputs.description: Radius of the generated curves. The radius also follows the growth scaling.
inputs.de: Radius of the generated curves. The radius also follows the growth scaling.
inputs.dz: 控制生成曲线的半径。曲线半径还会随生长缩放变化。

inputs.name: Density
inputs.description: Scatter density of curves on the mesh surface. The actual count depends on the mesh area and the animated range.
inputs.de: Scatter density of curves on the mesh surface. The actual count depends on the mesh area and the animated range.
inputs.dz: 控制网格表面的曲线散布密度。实际生成数量取决于网格面积和动画控制范围。

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.description: Random seed for scatter positions.
inputs.de: Random seed for scatter positions.
inputs.dz: 用于散布位置的随机种子。

inputs.name: Min
inputs.description: Minimum random scale of the curves. Random scale combines with the animated scale.
inputs.de: Minimum random scale of the curves. Random scale combines with the animated scale.
inputs.dz: 设置曲线随机缩放的最小值。随机缩放与动画控制的缩放共同作用。

inputs.name: Max
inputs.description: Maximum random scale of the curves. Random scale combines with the animated scale.
inputs.de: Maximum random scale of the curves. Random scale combines with the animated scale.
inputs.dz: 设置曲线随机缩放的最大值。随机缩放与动画控制的缩放共同作用。

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.description: Random seed for the random scale.
inputs.de: Random seed for the random scale.
inputs.dz: 用于随机缩放的随机种子。

inputs.name: Xy旋转随机
inputs.description: Amount of random rotation around the local X and Y axes.
inputs.de: Amount of random rotation around the local X and Y axes.
inputs.dz: 控制曲线绕局部 X、Y 轴的随机旋转幅度。

inputs.name: Z旋转随机
inputs.description: Amount of random rotation around the local Z axis.
inputs.de: Amount of random rotation around the local Z axis.
inputs.dz: 控制曲线绕局部 Z 轴的随机旋转幅度。

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.description: Random seed for the random rotation.
inputs.de: Random seed for the random rotation.
inputs.dz: 用于随机旋转的随机种子。

outputs.name: 几何数据
outputs.description: The original or trimmed mesh. The generated fiber curves are stored in the 曲线 (Curves) item of the geometry bundle.
outputs.de: The original or trimmed mesh. The generated fiber curves are stored in the 曲线 (Curves) item of the geometry bundle.
outputs.dz: 输出原网格或裁切后的网格。生成的纤维曲线存放在几何捆包的“曲线”项中。
